item.title: Red Hill Minerals Intersects Broad Lead-Zinc-Silver Mineralisation in Maiden Drilling at Broken Hill Project
item.description: Red Hill Minerals (ASX: RHI) has completed its maiden diamond drilling program at its Broken Hill project in New South Wales, intersecting broad zones of lead, zinc, and silver mineralisation across multiple targets.

item.title: Osteopore Expands Orthopaedic Business into Hong Kong with MontsMed Distribution Agreement
item.description: Osteopore (ASX: OSX) is set to expand its orthopaedic business into Hong Kong after signing a new distribution agreement with local company MontsMed, marking the next step in the company’s planned commercial expansion across the Asia Pacific region.

item.title: Nelson Resources Reports Spectacular Grades from Sampling At Gold Point Project
item.description: Rock-chip sampling by Nelson Resources (ASX: NES) at its newly acquired Gold Point project in the US state of Nevada has returned spectacular grades of up to 32.7 grams per tonne gold and 574g/t silver.

item.title: Impact Minerals Consolidates Broken Hill Landholding with Huonville Gold District Acquisition
item.description: Impact Minerals (ASX: IPT) has agreed to acquire a 100% interest in the Huonville gold district through the purchase of a 55-square-kilometre tenement located approximately 25 km south-east of Broken Hill in New South Wales.

item.title: Pure Foods Tasmania Initiates Contract Manufacturing Partnership with Brilliant Food Australia
item.description: Pure Foods Tasmania (ASX: PFT) has commenced contract manufacturing for Brilliant Food Australia, following the execution of a manufacturing agreement and the completion of initial production runs.

item.title: Celsius Resources Confirms Stronger Economics in MCB Copper-Gold Project DFS
item.description: Celsius Resources (ASX: CLA) has delivered a definitive feasibility study confirming improved technical and economic outcomes for its Maalinao-Caigutan-Biyog copper-gold project in the Philippines.

item.title: Verity Resources Confirms Low-Cost Development Potential at Monument Project in WA
item.description: Verity Resources (ASX: VRL) has received positive metallurgical test work results confirming the potential for low-cost production at its Monument gold project in Western Australia.

item.title: ABx Group Reports Strong Rare Earth Recoveries from Column Leach Tests at Deep Leads
item.description: ABx Group (ASX: ABX) has delivered strong results from rare earth column leach tests conducted on bulk samples from its Deep Leads project in northern Tasmania.

item.title: Lincoln Minerals Identifies Historical High-Grade Copper Targets at Southern Eyre Project
item.description: Lincoln Minerals (ASX: LML) has identified multiple high-grade copper targets at its Southern Eyre project in South Australia following a detailed review of historical exploration data.

item.title: Weekly Wrap: Rising rates lift AUD and gold as miners lead ASX gains
item.description: Gold hits fresh highs and miners rally as rates rise; Life360 soars on upbeat guidance, AUD hits 16-month peak, ASX 200 slips 0.5% for the week.
